text:
Mia A.: Heads-up — AuroraHealth wants to move the POC to contract review. They pushed a PO + DPA redlines this morning. Can we get procurement path sorted?
Sam W.: Saw the packet. They attached a PO and a DPA with a KMS requirement and a 90-day data deletion clause.
Lena (Legal): Upload the exact redline PDF and the clause lines they flagged. I only skimmed.
Mia A.: Dropped the files here: https://files.redwood.internal/aurora/aurora_dpa_redline_2026.pdf
Patrick S.: Quick Q: does Aurora require invoice to reference their project code? And do they want e-sign or DocuSign embedded?
Mia A.: Yes on project code. They prefer DocuSign with signers: Procurement Manager -> Legal -> Finance.
Ravi (Solutions): From a tech POV, their KMS ask is "bring-your-own-key via AWS KMS" for logs+models. We can support envelope encryption for artifacts but need to confirm telemetry.
Lena (Legal): The DPA redline has two sticky points: 1) 90-day deletion for backups (we usually do 180 days in archive) and 2) KMS control for model input/outputs — we need an exception path.
Sam W.: Can we offer a compromise: operational backups 180d but customer-accessible artifacts purged in 90d?
Patrick S.: Procurement also flagged SLA language: they want a financial SLA credit at 99.5% monthly uptime. Our Dedicated contract has 99.9% for reserved capacity — can we accept 99.5% for hosted?
Mia A.: Aurora's RFP calls for 99.5% on hosted endpoints — they'd like credits for production incidents.
Lena (Legal): We can accept a 99.5% SLA with standard credit tiers. I'll draft language. Need Sales Ops to confirm pricing impact.
Patrick S.: I'll run numbers — if we lower SLA from standard 99.9 -> 99.5 we should increase the monthly minimum or adjust unit price. I'll ping finance.
Ravi (Solutions): One technical blocker: BYOK for KMS plus streaming inference means key rotation windows could break existing in-flight sessions. We need to document operational constraints to put in the SOW.
Sam W.: Good call. Can you draft a short ops bullet we can insert into the order form? e.g.:
```
BYOK KMS integration: Customer-managed KMS keys supported for storage and telemetry. Key rotations may cause short-lived session interruptions; recommended rotation window: weekly with a 2-hour maintenance window. Redwood will provide key rotation playbook.
```
Lena (Legal): Also need to add explicit indemnity carveout for BYOK misuse and clarify responsibilities for key compromise.
Mia A.: Aurora also asked: can we sign their PO first and finish DPA redlines after? Procurement prefers PO to set billing.
Lena (Legal): We can accept PO signature only if we add a conditional clause: "Execution of PO is subject to agreement on DPA and MSA terms within 30 days" — otherwise risk.
Patrick S.: Sales Ops: route for signatures should be: Mia -> Aurora Procurement -> Aurora Legal -> Redwood Finance -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood Exec (if required). Can we automate with DocuSign routing?
Patrick S.: @AuroraProcBot please create routing envelope with fields: PO#12345, project code AH-2026-P1, signer order as above.
AuroraProcBot: Envelope created: https://docusign.redwood/ENV-9931 (status: draft).
Sam W.: Heads-up for SEs: if they sign PO now, don't onboard traffic until DPA/MSA exceptions cleared. Document that in the playbook.
Lena (Legal): I'll prepare the DPA response and an exception log for KMS + deletion. Expect a draft in ~4 hours.
Mia A.: Thanks team. Can someone confirm pricing delta if we accept 99.5 SLA + BYOK support? I need final numbers for Aurora by EOD.
Patrick S.: I'll have an initial pricing delta by 15:00 PT.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll attach the BYOK runbook and the limitation note to the DocuSign envelope after Lena's clause is in.
Mia A.: Great. I'll update Aurora with: (a) we can sign PO with conditional DPA/MSA sign-off in 30 days, (b) we support BYOK with operational caveats, (c) pricing delta and SLA to follow by 15:00 PT. :+1:
Lena (Legal): Noted. If Aurora pushes for immediate production before DPA complete, escalate to me.
Mia A.: Copy that.
Patrick S.: tagging finance now. <@finance-team> can you standby for the pricing change?
Finance team (auto): Received. Reviewing.
Mia A.: Closing loop — folks, once we have Lena's DPA draft and Patrick's pricing delta, I'll reply to Aurora and update the DocuSign envelope.
Lena (Legal): Draft posted: https://wip.redwood/legal/aurora_dpa_response_210250.pdf
Patrick S.: Pricing delta: +18% on hosted per-token rates for SLA downgrade + $2k/mo BYOK ops fee (temp). Numbers tentative until legal clears.
Mia A.: Perfect. I'll send to Aurora and request PO sign routing.
Sam W.: Thx — SEs on standby for POC kickoff after signature.
Mia A.: Done — sending update to Aurora now.
